title: Sustainable bio-based isocyanate-free poly (urethane amic acid) coatings for the corrosion protection of mild steel
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00835B, Paper
Open Access

Rakesh Rapolu, Kashmiri Borah, P. Ermiya Prasad, Aqueeb Javeed, Aruna Palanisamy
A sustainable, isocyanate-free coating from castor oil was developed, combining good thermal stability, corrosion protection, and mechanical durability, highlighting its potential as an eco-friendly alternative for metal surfaces.
